relations.title: Coeficiente de recuperación de capacidad (ρ)
relations.reading: Carrier availability at an activation threshold and the HID recovery coefficient answer different questions: who can respond now, and what capability returns after the architecture changes.

relations.title: Transmisión de juicio tácito
relations.reading: Tacit-knowledge transmission offers a practical route for making activation capacity less dependent on a few irreplaceable carriers at the critical moment.

relations.title: Ventana de respuesta
relations.reading: A deadline is not a readiness condition: a bounded action still needs valid evidence, authority and resources within its declared decision window.

relations.title: Activación entre tipos de frontera
relations.reading: The frontier-activation essay suggests a further study of how conditions at one interface enable another, with each capability and observation level defined separately.

relations.title: Carga de coordinación
relations.reading: The synthetic reduction distinguishes recognizing an opportunity from activating it, and shows why an equally informed conventional controller must remain a serious comparator.

relations.title: Carga de coordinación
relations.reading: A useful activation study could test information and joint coordination separately and together, rather than attributing every improvement to additional awareness alone.

relations.reading: The synthetic agentic reduction offers a bounded comparison of knowing an opportunity and activating it through an authorized joint transition.

relations.title: Orden parcial de dimensiones no fungibles
relations.reading: An activation can improve output while worsening coordination burden; without a justified conversion rule, that is a trade-off rather than an unqualified improvement.
